name: claude-crlf-file
description: The file on disk uses CRLF line endings, but the scenario lists lines WITHOUT terminators, as the line policy defines them: `a\r\n` is the line `a`, so CRLF and LF files have the same lines and the same hashes. A Claude edit changes one line; the neighbours are context, the rest is base. The last base line holds a lone `\r` in the middle (`progress=10%` carriage-returned over `20%`): that is content, not a terminator, so it is an ordinary untouched base line. Whether the edit wrote CRLF or LF is invisible by policy and does not change any origin.
